column1: Faded lovers when we run from the dark
To dance with others who we face in the ark
Of time that's leaving our bodies behind
So tired of grieving in our hearts and our minds
Distant from each other, we change in the dark of the season
Left to only wonder, we wait for the light to arrive
Yearning for another, we burn through the loss and the leaving
Sacred memories that leave us in time
Lost in motion as we struggle to find
A place to keep them forever close to our hearts
For safe keeping when we run from the dark
Tired of resisting, we black out the sound of our worries
Dreaming in the distance we're chasing the night from the sky
Pain still existing, we think we can heal in a hurry
